title: Book Three · Chapter 151: In the Other City
story:
At half past twelve in the other city, Anna opens her notebook beside a long worktable.

She and her mother arrived by bus at ten. They walked to the school and showed their confirmation before a quarter to eleven.

Now the afternoon part of the visit is starting. Their packed lunch is finished. Anna has a pencil ready.

A student puts two drawings beside a model. One drawing shows a building from the street. The other shows its rooms from above.

Anna moves closer. She has tried both views herself. Here, she can follow the same wall from one drawing to the next.

“Did you make the model first?” she asks.

“A rough one,” the student says. “Then we changed the drawing and tried again.”

She lifts part of the roof. Anna can see the little rooms beneath it.

Her mother comes beside her and looks down.

“A lot of work for one corner.”

“We spent a long time on that corner,” the student says.

Anna shows her the stair drawing. The student studies the top step, then asks about its height.

Anna looks at her own lines.

“I need to check that.”

She writes the question beside the step. A teacher comes over, and she asks him about the maths in the lessons.

He shows her another page of measurements. She copies two useful questions for her own teacher at home.

Her mother asks to see the shared rooms later. They follow a small group upstairs and look at the beds and work space.

Anna stands beside a window for a moment. She can hear students talking farther along the passage.

She wants to learn more here. She also has more places to ask about.

At three, the visit ends. Anna and her mother walk back to the station. The long bus journey home is still ahead.

Her mother buys two warm drinks for one yuan each. She has two yuan left in her purse.

They sit near the waiting room window. Anna opens her notebook again and starts to describe the model's roof.

“I saw it,” her mother says gently.

Anna laughs and closes the page for a while. They eat the bread left in their lunch bag.

At six, their bus leaves. It reaches their own city about nine. Anna is tired as they walk home, but she keeps the notebook close beneath her coat.

At home, she puts it beside tomorrow's clothes. The stair question is still at the top of the page.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

rough＝初步的、粗略的；measurement＝量得的尺寸；passage＝走廊、过道；packed lunch＝从家带好的午餐。

## 理解问题

1. Anna实际看见、提出并带回了哪些学习问题？这是否等于申请或录取？
2. 母女怎样返回本城？额外四元实际花了多少、剩下多少？

## 读句子

**She writes the question beside the step.**

拆开看：She / writes the question / beside the step.

她／把问题记下来／写在那级台阶旁。
